standard.coverage: Employers with 4 or more employees at any one time.
standard.note: Third step of 2022 Initiative 433. LB 258, signed 2026-02-09, then rewrote what comes next: the voter-approved CPI escalator due to start in 2027 was replaced with a fixed 1.75% annual increase, and two new sub-minimum wages were created. 2027: $15.26 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: Nebraska pairs a $15.00 standard rate with the FEDERAL $2.13 cash wage -- a $12.87 tip credit, the largest of any US jurisdiction.

variants.label: Non-emancipated employees aged 14-15
variants.test: LB 258 (2026), effective 2026-07-17. Rises 1.5% every five years beginning 2030-01-01.

variants.label: Training wage, employees aged 16-19
variants.test: LB 258 (2026), effective 2026-07-17, for the first 90 days. Rises 1.5% annually beginning 2027.

indexation.basis: fixed 1.75% per year from 2027 (LB 258 replaced Initiative 433's CPI escalator)
indexation.note: Nebraska's Department of Labor publishes the following year's figure each October 15.
